task: Hand-repair STICKUP shoulder skin weights (unlock full taunt range)
resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — do what a AAA tech artist does: hand-fix the broken auto-weights on Stick-Up's shoulders. CONTEXT: STICKUP_repaired.glb (~/workspace/bannon-video-pipe/repo/assets/models/STICKUP_repaired.glb) has machine-generated skin weights. Measured safe envelope: upper arm webs past 15deg forward raise, 10deg lateral — the crucifix and extended finger-gun taunts are impossible. 20+ Blender probe frames proved it. The shipped v2 video (865a691d) choreographed inside the envelope, but the owner wants the real taunts. YOUR JOB: (1) Work on a COPY — output STICKUP_v3.glb next to the original in assets/models/ (NEVER overwrite STICKUP_repaired.glb); (2) in Blender 4.0.2 headless (~/workspace/tools/blender/blender-4.0.2-linux-x64/blender, env -u PYTHONPATH), inspect the armature: find the shoulder/clavicle/upper-arm joints and their weight maps — the webbing comes from armpit/shoulder vertices bound ~100% to the upper-arm bone with no falloff; (3) repaint by hand (scripted weight painting): smooth gradient clavicle->upper-arm->forearm, armpit vertices get blended clavicle/chest/upper-arm weights, no vertex at 100% to a single arm bone near the joint; if the rig lacks twist joints, distribute twist by adding an upper-arm twist bone ONLY if you can do it without breaking the existing animations — otherwise document it as future work; (4) VERIFY with probe renders: arm forward raise at 15/30/45/60/90deg and lateral raise at 15/30/45/60/90deg — ZERO webbing/stretch/flap at every angle, eye-check each frame and list them; also run promo_gates.py --measure on the new GLB and quote the rotation number (old: 22.797deg FAIL); (5) commit the script + the new GLB to a NEW branch stickup-shoulder-repair (from main), push, open a PR — never touch main directly. DO NOT re-render the video — this is model surgery only; the video rebuild comes after. RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint after every step; verification law (probe frames or it didn't happen); reuse don't duplicate (check tools/entrance-video/ for the existing probe scripts); commit incrementally. Report: what you changed in the weights, the probe angles with zero-defect confirmation, the new gate numbers, PR link.
result: FAILED to meet zero-webbing bar. 6 automated repaints + Corrective Smooth all failed. PR #50 documents attempts. Manual Prisma 3D work required.
